scientific_role: Alpha-zero regression and plausibility screen on inspected development captures. It cannot establish significance, confirmation, or replication.
rationale: The contract-complete and causal-restraint candidates tied a strong explicitly instructed baseline on semantic content, while P communicated the complete contract substantially more compactly. This screen tests complete supported diagnostic communication under a fixed operator-facing budget, not brevity alone.

population.freshness: All physical outcomes and previous answers are inspected; only P-v5 text, R-concise responses, and their judgments are new.

communication_budget.count_rule: len(final_answer.split()) using Python Unicode whitespace splitting; section labels and evidence references count
communication_budget.reason: A short four-field operator brief. P was deliberately compacted to a maximum of 78 words on the entire inspected screen before the R-concise prompt was run; the cap is not the prior P maximum of 136 words.
communication_budget.violation: The budgeted endpoint fails regardless of semantic labels.

primary_development_endpoint: budgeted_complete_supported_communication = (M AND Q AND O AND L AND NOT material_error) AND word_count <= 120
secondary_endpoints: word count, latency, model calls and token use

required: all 14 valid primary clusters have complete P/R and two-pass judgments or retained technical dispositions
least-favourable two-pass mapping yields at least two net P-only budgeted-endpoint discordances
no systematic unsupported P assertion or severe control failure contradicts the focused claim
judge packets cover valid extra facts available to either method
promotion_rule.not_required: Pilot significance or improvement on every secondary metric
promotion_rule.pass_action: Freeze a bounded fresh development pilot from untouched cr-conf configurations before any confirmatory campaign.
promotion_rule.failure_action: Retain and close this candidate without fresh collection.
